Arvind V.

LinkedIn GitHub Email

I’m external Faculty at the Srishti Manipal Institute of Art and Design, and Engineering Manager at MMRFIC, both in Bangalore, INDIA, and a Certified Level #1 TRIZ Professional.

I have a passion for Data Visualization, coding in R / ObservableJS / p5.js, Complexity Science, Literature, and Creative Thinking / Problem Solving with TRIZ. On this website, I share and teach what I learned about TRIZ, a Russian System for Structured, Inventive Problem Solving. To get started, you can check out the Modules on this website.

My teaching websites are:

  • TRIZ for Problem Solvers (This one!!)
  • Data Viz and Stats in R
  • Data Visualization with No Code
  • Model Thinking in Design
  • Literary Jukebox: Design Thinking from Short Fiction
  • Maths for Creative Coders
  • Intro to Design of Experiments in R (Extreme Work in Progress!)
